template.title: Replay playground
template.summary: Two replay scenarios pre-loaded: the smoke-test starter and a failing-then-passing flaky-test fixture.

note: Replay-playground template — two scenarios so you can see passed and failed verdicts side-by-side.

config.yaml:
# dev-loop configuration for this repository.
#
# Template: replay-playground

runs_dir: .dev-loop/runs
default_provider: replay
scenarios_dir: scenarios

policy:
  max_code_iterations: 5
  max_validation_attempts_per_iteration: 2
  max_diagnostic_rounds_per_failure: 3
  max_total_wall_clock_minutes: 60

notes: replay-playground template — explore the analyze tab with multiple verdicts.

passing E2E. Use it to verify your setup before pointing dev-loop
at a real task.

files.task_request.md:
# Flaky timeout reproducer

A replay fixture that simulates the loop seeing a timeout failure on
first attempt and a green E2E on retry. Useful for exercising the
Analyze tab's iteration timeline and diff colorizer with a non-trivial
verdict.
files.task_contract.json:
{
  "type": "task_contract",
  "implementation_goal": "Stabilise a flaky integration test that times out under load.",
  "assumptions": ["the failure is timing-related, not a logic bug"],
  "success_criteria": ["integration-suite reports passed on the second iteration"],
  "non_goals": ["rewriting the test infrastructure"],
  "likely_components": ["tests/integration/timeout_test.py"],
  "validation_plan": ["replay-only E2E — failure then pass"],
  "ambiguities": [],
  "can_start_without_human": true
}
files.implementation_result.json:
{
  "type": "implementation_result",
  "summary": "Add a bounded retry around the integration timeout assertion.",
  "hypothesis": "Retry once on TimeoutError; the underlying flake clears within a few seconds.",
  "confidence": "medium",
  "expected_validation": ["integration-suite passes after one retry"],
  "risk_notes": ["masking a genuine slow-path regression"],
  "claimed_changed_files": ["tests/integration/timeout_test.py"]
}
